en.headline: Man dies after being struck by Citybus while crossing in North Point
en.dek: A man in his forties was hit by a Citybus at about 8:17am on King's Road near Tin Chong Street; he was pronounced dead at Eastern Hospital at 8:54am.
body: Police are investigating a fatal traffic accident in North Point this morning in which a man in his forties died after being struck by a Citybus.

Officers received a report from the bus driver at 8:17am that the vehicle had collided with a pedestrian at the junction of King's Road and Tin Chong Street while travelling towards Chai Wan. Emergency crews found the man with serious head injuries and unconscious; he was taken to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital, where he was certified dead at 8:54am.

Local reports indicated the man was using a pedestrian crossing and may not have crossed according to the traffic lights. The left side of the Citybus windscreen was shattered. The Transport Department later said some lanes on King's Road towards Chai Wan near the junction had been reopened.
Police are continuing to investigate the circumstances of the collision.

zh.headline: 北角男途人疑過路遭城巴撞飛 送院後不治
zh.dek: 今早約8時17分，一名約40歲男子在北角英皇道近電廠街橫過馬路時遭城巴撞倒，送東區醫院後於8時54分證實死亡。
body: 警方正調查今早北角一宗致命交通意外，一名約40歲男子被城巴撞倒後不治。
警方於上午8時17分接獲城巴司機報案，指巴士沿英皇道往柴灣方向駛至電廠街交界時撞倒一名途人。救援人員到場發現事主頭部嚴重受傷並陷入昏迷，隨即送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院，最終於上午8時54分被證實死亡。
現場消息指，事主當時使用行人過路處橫過馬路，懷疑未有依照交通燈號過路，被城巴撞飛逾十米。城巴車頭左邊擋風玻璃嚴重碎裂。運輸署其後表示，英皇道往柴灣方向近電廠街的部分行車線已解封。
